name: render-remaining-material-pages
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
p=Path.cwd()
for stem,page in [('parking',4),('evidence',20),('evidence',22)]:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1500','-singlefile','-png',str(p/'inputs'/f'{stem}.pdf')],capture_output=True,timeout=15);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'visual/{stem}-{page}.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(z.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0,w.stderr
 print(stem,page)
print('RAW', (p/'inputs/original323531.raw.jsonl').read_text())
